title: 🎧Ep 625: The Next Leap in Professional Wine Education with Keith Wallace of the Wine School of Philadelphia
summary: Keith Wallace is the founder of The Wine School Philadelphia, which is respected and known throughout the wine industry. In 2001, Keith opened a small wine school in Philly and, from a grassroots effort, built The Wine School Philadelphia into the most influential independent wine school in the country. He is a passionate advocate for integrity in the industry and for wine education.   And in a revolutionary move for wine education, he has created a US-based sommelier certification agency that doesn't rely on foreign oversight (like the Court of Master Sommeliers or the Wine & Spirits Education Trust) and that offers REAL credentials to wine professionals looking to get into the industry or to improve their knowledge of wine. That effort comes from the National Wine School and from the Philly Wine School, which offer classes in person and online. Both grant a recognized trade-school credential for students. Today, the Philly Wine School offers classes in wine, beer, spirits, and cocktails, all taught by top professionals. Alumni work across the industry: in wineries, restaurants, import firms, and media outlets.   Keith talks about the evolution of this program over the last 25 years. We discuss how a practical trade school education in wine is needed and the gaps in current programming that this credential and trade school fill.   _____________________________________________________ Full show notes and all back episodes are on Patreon. title: 🎧Pines, Whines, & Safeway Wines: Surviving Healdsburg’s Worst Tasting Room
summary: It’s Monday, Let’s raise a glass to the beginning of another week. It’s time to unscrew, uncork or saber a bottle and let’s begin Exploring the Wine Glass.  This week  we took a lovely little field trip to Healdsburg that rapidly devolved into a wine country survival expedition. If you’ve ever wanted to know what happens when a tasting room experience involves accidentally becoming an unpaid cave guide, enduring pours that taste like a high school science experiment gone wrong, and staging a desperate, clandestine rescue mission to aisle four at Safeway, this episode is your holy grail. Pour yourself something you actually trust, because we are diving headfirst into our most delightfully disastrous adventure yet!  Please take a moment of your time to subscribe, rate and review Exploring the Wine Glass. It’s completely free and is a great way to let other wine lovers know about the podcast. Be sure to head over to the website, Exploringthewineglass.com, to read my award winning blog and to see what else I have been up to.
